metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ,
units.rightText: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the elect who are sojourners of the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

units.leftText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance. A Living Hope
units.rightText: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

units.leftText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
units.rightText: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy begat us again unto a living hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
leftNotes: 1:3 Or has caused us to be born again or has begotten us again

units.leftText: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
units.rightText: unto an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

units.leftText: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
units.rightText: who by the power of God are guarded through faith unto a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

units.leftText: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
units.rightText: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, ye have been put to grief in manifold trials,

units.leftText: so that the proven character of your faith — more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire — may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: that the proof of your faith, being more precious than gold that perisheth though it is proved by fire, may be found unto praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

units.leftText: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
units.rightText: whom not having seen ye love; on whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

units.leftText: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
units.rightText: receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

units.leftText: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
units.rightText: Concerning which salvation the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

units.leftText: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
units.rightText: searching what time or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did point unto, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow them.

units.leftText: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things. A Call to Holiness (Hebrews 12:14–17|HEB 12:14-17*)
units.rightText: To whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto you, did they minister these things, which now have been announced unto you through them that preached the gospel unto you by the Holy Spirit sent forth from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

units.leftText: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Wherefore girding up the loins of your mind, be sober and set your hope perfectly on the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
leftNotes: 1:13 Literally Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind

units.leftText: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
units.rightText: as children of obedience, not fashioning yourselves according to your former lusts in the time of your ignorance:

units.leftText: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
units.rightText: but like as he who called you is holy, be ye yourselves also holy in all manner of living;

units.leftText: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
units.rightText: because it is written, Ye shall be holy; for I am holy.

units.leftText: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
units.rightText: And if ye call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to each man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning in fear:

units.leftText: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
units.rightText: knowing that ye were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from your fathers;

units.leftText: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
units.rightText: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, even the blood of Christ:

units.leftText: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
units.rightText: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was manifested at the end of the times for your sake,

units.leftText: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God. The Enduring Word (Isaiah 40:6–8|ISA 40:6-8*)
units.rightText: who through him are believers in God, that raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

units.leftText: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
units.rightText: Seeing ye have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth unto unfeigned love of the brethren, love one another from the heart fervently:
leftNotes: 1:22 SBL, NE, and WH from the heart

units.leftText: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
units.rightText: having been begotten again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which liveth and abideth.

units.leftText: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
units.rightText: For, All flesh is as grass, And all the glory thereof as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower falleth:

units.leftText: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
units.rightText: But the word of the Lord abideth for ever. And this is the word of good tidings which was preached unto you.

units.leftText: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
units.rightText: Putting away therefore all wickedness, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

units.leftText: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
units.rightText: as newborn babes, long for the spiritual milk which is without guile, that ye may grow thereby unto salvation;

units.leftText: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
units.rightText: if ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

units.leftText: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
units.rightText: unto whom coming, a living stone, rejected indeed of men, but with God elect, precious,

units.leftText: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: ye also, as living stones, are built up a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
units.rightText: Because it is contained in scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.

units.leftText: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
units.rightText: For you therefore that believe is the preciousness: but for such as disbelieve, The stone which the builders rejected, The same was made the head of the corner;

units.leftText: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word— and to this they were appointed.
units.rightText: and, A stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence; for they stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

units.leftText: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
units.rightText: But ye are an elect race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that ye may show forth the excellencies of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

units.leftText: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
units.rightText: who in time past were no people, but now are the people of God: who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

units.leftText: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
units.rightText: Beloved, I beseech you as sojourners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

units.leftText: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us. Submission to Authorities (Romans 13:1–7|ROM 13:1-7*)
units.rightText: having your behavior seemly among the Gentiles; that, wherein they speak against you as evil-doers, they may by your good works, which they behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

units.leftText: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
units.rightText: Be subject to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

units.leftText: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
units.rightText: or unto governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evil-doers and for praise to them that do well.

units.leftText: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
units.rightText: For so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

units.leftText: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
units.rightText: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

units.leftText: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
units.rightText: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

units.leftText: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
units.rightText: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

units.leftText: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
units.rightText: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.

units.leftText: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God. Christ’s Example of Suffering (Isaiah 53:1–8|ISA 53:1-8*)
units.rightText: For what glory is it, if, when ye sin, and are buffeted for it, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye shall take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

units.leftText: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
units.rightText: For hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that ye should follow his steps:

units.leftText: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
units.rightText: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

units.leftText: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
units.rightText: who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

units.leftText: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
units.rightText: who his own self bare our sins in his body upon the tree, that we, having died unto sins, might live unto righteousness; by whose stripes ye were healed.

units.leftText: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
units.rightText: For ye were going astray like sheep; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

units.leftText: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
units.rightText: In like manner, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, even if any obey not the word, they may without the word be gained by the behavior of their wives;

units.leftText: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
units.rightText: beholding your chaste behavior coupled with fear.

units.leftText: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
units.rightText: Whose adorning let it not be the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on apparel;

units.leftText: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
units.rightText: but let it be the hidden man of the heart, in the incorruptible apparel of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

units.leftText: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
units.rightText: For after this manner aforetime the holy women also, who hoped in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

units.leftText: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
units.rightText: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose children ye now are, if ye do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

units.leftText: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered. Turning from Evil
units.rightText: Ye husbands, in like manner, dwell with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor unto the woman, as unto the weaker vessel, as being also joint-heirs of the grace of life; to the end that your prayers be not hindered.

units.leftText: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
units.rightText: Finally, be ye all likeminded, compassionate, loving as brethren, tenderhearted, humbleminded:

units.leftText: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
units.rightText: not rendering evil for evil, or reviling for reviling; but contrariwise blessing; for hereunto were ye called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

units.leftText: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
units.rightText: For, He that would love life, And see good days, Let him refrain his tongue from evil, And his lips that they speak no guile:

units.leftText: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
units.rightText: And let him turn away from evil, and do good; Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

units.leftText: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
units.rightText: For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, And his ears unto their supplication: But the face of the Lord is upon them that do evil.

units.leftText: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good? Suffering for Righteousness
units.rightText: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be zealous of that which is good?

units.leftText: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
units.rightText: But even if ye should suffer for righteousness’ sake, blessed are ye: and fear not their fear, neither be troubled;
leftNotes: 3:14 Or “Do not fear their threats; do not be shaken.”Isaiah 8:12|ISA 8:12*

units.leftText: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
units.rightText: but sanctify in your hearts Christ as Lord: being ready always to give answer to every man that asketh you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, yet with meekness and fear:
leftNotes: 3:15 BYZ and TR But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts.This sentence may also be included with the quotation from the previous verse; see Isaiah 8:13|ISA 8:13*.

units.leftText: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
units.rightText: having a good conscience; that, wherein ye are spoken against, they may be put to shame who revile your good manner of life in Christ.

units.leftText: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
units.rightText: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.

units.leftText: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
units.rightText: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

units.leftText: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
units.rightText: in which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison,

units.leftText: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built.
units.rightText: that aforetime were disobedient, when the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water:

units.leftText: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also — not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God — through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
units.rightText: which also after a true likeness doth now save you, even baptism, not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the interrogation of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ;

units.leftText: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
units.rightText: who is on the right hand of God, having gone into heaven; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

units.leftText: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
units.rightText: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered in the flesh, arm ye yourselves also with the same mind; for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
leftNotes: 4:1 BYZ and TR include for us.

units.leftText: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
units.rightText: that ye no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

units.leftText: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
units.rightText: For the time past may suffice to have wrought the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in lasciviousness, lusts, winebibbings, revellings, carousings, and abominable idolatries:

units.leftText: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
units.rightText: wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

units.leftText: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
units.rightText: who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the living and the dead.

units.leftText: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
units.rightText: For unto this end was the gospel preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
leftNotes: 4:6 Or to those who are dead

units.leftText: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
units.rightText: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore of sound mind, and be sober unto prayer:

units.leftText: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
units.rightText: above all things being fervent in your love among yourselves; for love covereth a multitude of sins:

units.leftText: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
units.rightText: using hospitality one to another without murmuring:

units.leftText: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
units.rightText: according as each hath received a gift, ministering it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;

units.leftText: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen. Suffering as Christians
units.rightText: if any man speaketh, speaking as it were oracles of God; if any man ministereth, ministering as of the strength which God supplieth: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
units.rightText: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial among you, which cometh upon you to prove you, as though a strange thing happened unto you:

units.leftText: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
units.rightText: but insomuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory also ye may rejoice with exceeding joy.

units.leftText: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
units.rightText: If ye are reproached for the name of Christ, blessed are ye; because the Spirit of glory and the Spirit of God resteth upon you.
leftNotes: 4:14 BYZ and TR include On their part He is spoken of as evil, but on your part He is glorified.

units.leftText: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
units.rightText: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil-doer, or as a meddler in other men’s matters:

units.leftText: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
units.rightText: but if a man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
leftNotes: 4:16 Literally glorify God in that name; NA glorify God in this matter

units.leftText: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
units.rightText: For the time is come for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if it begin first at us, what shall be the end of them that obey not the gospel of God?

units.leftText: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
units.rightText: And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and sinner appear?

units.leftText: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
units.rightText: Wherefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing unto a faithful Creator.

units.leftText: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
units.rightText: The elders therefore among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
leftNotes: 5:1 SBL, NE, and WH I appeal therefore to the elders

units.leftText: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
units.rightText: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to the will of God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
leftNotes: 5:2 NE and WH do not include watching over them.
5:2 WH, BYZ, and TR but willingly

units.leftText: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
units.rightText: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.

units.leftText: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away. Cast Your Cares on Him
units.rightText: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.

units.leftText: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
units.rightText: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.

units.leftText: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
units.rightText: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

units.leftText: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
units.rightText: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.

units.leftText: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
units.rightText: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

units.leftText: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering. Benediction and Farewell
units.rightText: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.

units.leftText: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
units.rightText: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
leftNotes: 5:10 BYZ and TR in Christ Jesus

units.leftText: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: To him be the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
units.rightText: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account him, I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God: stand ye fast therein.

units.leftText: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
units.rightText: She that is in Babylon, elect together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.

units.leftText: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
units.rightText: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
